gaps: No dated opening or closing announcement for Pensi La found for 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 or 2026.
No source says whether motorcycles were allowed at opening in any year.
No official source found for the rule that Zanskar needs no permit; whether foreign citizens need one was not established.
No timing or one-way rule found for Pensi La.
Which office decides the opening of Pensi La was not established; the highway is maintained by a central corporation and closures are announced by Kargil police.
Whether the restriction on rental motorcycles from outside Ladakh is enforced in Kargil and Zanskar was not found.
The official account of District Police Kargil was not opened; its advisory was read in local news.
No website found for the new Zanskar district.
A blogger's two pages disagree on whether the Ladakh tourist fee applies on this road.
Video filming dates are not stated; they were published on 8 October 2025 and 24 September 2025. Both run from Padum towards Kargil.

pumps_from_companies.why: The open map has no pump between Sankoo and Padum. Neither IndianOil's nor HP's own locator, read on 6 October 2026 for Kargil, lists one there either, so the gap stays and nothing is added.
